name: OpenCorporates
tagline: World's largest open database of companies and corporate ownership networks
description: OpenCorporates provides programmatic access to company registry data, officers, filings, and corporate ownership relationships across many jurisdictions. Developers use it for KYC, due diligence, entity resolution, and graph-style linkage of companies and people. The API returns structured company records with registry identifiers, status, registered addresses, and related entities.

auth.details: API token via api_token query parameter (or account signup); free accounts limited; paid plans for higher volume

use_cases: search companies by name across global registries
look up a company by jurisdiction and company number
list officers and directors for a company
trace corporate ownership and network relationships
enrich KYC or due-diligence workflows with registry status
